No passage-role explanatory tails observed in the original-entry meanings. Meanings and tags follow zh/en/ja; hints and prose remain English. This does not certify every lexical definition.
Ten of 75 original-entry hints contain inflection; no required inflection percentage introduced.
Every upstream response passage is one paragraph. The longest failed combined passage has 2540 words yet still misses prevalent; no upper-bound or segmentation requirement added.

Case 5 and 6 frame gambling gains/visits as relief from unemployment or melancholy. Case 15 instead leaves gambling for training; stories are not uniformly the same. These are narrative-quality observations, not new bans.
Case 13 changes Tariq to Tara once; case 15 shifts from watching/hearing news to rereading/folding a paper without introducing it. Minor continuity observations kept separate from interface outcomes.
The melancholy-to-melancholic fix is still not exercised by the current live sample; prior offline proof is not mislabeled as live coverage.
quality.conclusion: Bounded continuation rescues 2 GLM runs but none of 2 MiniMax eligible runs. Current 80% and combined r9 82.6% do not meet the 90% target. Small mixed samples and different counts per model do not justify a stable production-rate claim. Interface success does not imply content-quality acceptance.
